verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs list a "Browser Sandbox" offering "Managed browser sessions for interactive workflows" (docs-8). Separate docs describe interactive actions after scraping, such as clicking, filling forms and navigating deeper (docs-3), and the hosted cloud service supports the managed aspect (gh-10). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of sandbox session lifecycle and of manual or live-view browsing control, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
